jobs.occupation: In-Service Support Project Engineer (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Materialwissenschaften)
jobs.employer_name: Rheinmetall AG
jobs.description:
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

The BOXER 8x8 is the leading armoured vehicle with a multi-national user background that has been developed in a joint co-operation programme between Germany and the Netherlands by the international consortium ARTEC GmbH in Munich, Germany. ARTEC is a joint-venture of KNDS Deutschland GmbH & Co. KG, Rheinmetall Landsysteme GmbH and Rheinmetall Defence Nederland B.V. It is the prime contractor responsible for the BOXER Programme, the co-ordination of series production and the focal point for export opportunities. By December 2025, more than 2,000 BOXER vehicles had been contracted. Further large-scale projects are in the pipeline.

In the role of In-Service Support Engineer for the BOXER program you are responsible to support international costumers and the representative agency, NATO Support and Procurement Agency (NSPA), during the In-Service support phase of the leading multi-national 8x8 military armoured vehicle. At the industry consortium ARTEC, all technical and cross-discipline activities are focused on making a good product even better to protect the future and security of Europe and Worldwide.

Parts of the BOXER of ISS Project Engineer role:

- Preparation, execution and completion of follow-up for meetings with prime contractors and customers within the scope In-Service Support phase
- Attending and supporting regularly held customer meetings (Multinational Configuration Control Board, Logistic Control Board etc.)
- Monitoring and tracking the Engineering and Logistical Change Proposals and other deliveries under the continuous service
- Supporting in the preparation of periodic reports (quarterly progress reports, risk reports etc.)
- Supporting the offer preparation process for the Service on Request from the customer
- Coordination of ARTEC`s Main Subcontractors
- Ensuring coordination between the departments of ARTEC that have responsibilities within the scope of In-Service Support phase
- Continuous improvement of processes and monitoring of KPIs
- Supporting and deputizing the In-Service Support Manager of ARTEC
- Bachelor's degree, engineer, technician or comparable qualification
- Previous experience in customer support and/or with the NSPA is advantageous
- Basic understanding of ILS sub-disciplines and their interaction with each other
- Basic understanding of Configuration Management process
- Experience in contract management is advantageous
- Strong organizational and communication skills
- Ability to quickly understand and facilitate complex technical relations
- Hands on mentality
- Business fluent in English written and spoken
- Strong scheduling/ planning skills

ARTEC is characterized by a flat hierarchy with a project-matrix organisation. This provides the opportunity for you as BOXER ISS Project Engineer to work on a international project with different team members from different countries at the same time.

The office is located in Munich - the most liveable city in Germany.

- Interesting and varied opportunities in a leading role for large scale and demanding International and National projects across the whole life cycle (development, series production, In-Service Support) of a state-of-the art military vehicle.
- Development opportunities for both personal and professional growth within the organization.
- Individual training opportunities offered by externals as well as a consortium owned academy.
- An office that is easily accessible by public or private transport within Munich.
- Attractive payment package and pension.
- 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family.
- Flexible working hours incl. 40% mobile working possible as a standard.
- Wide range of corporate benefits.
- Offsite and team building events to underline the modern working environment.
- Medical service at the location.
- Job Bike.
- Subsidized D-Ticket.
- Access to EGYM Wellpass.

Join exceptional people from around the world to solve some of the world's toughest energy challenges, make a real impact, and enjoy the adventure of building the future of industrial decarbonization together.

As our Structural Engineer – Material Testing & Structural Validation, you'll play a key role in developing the lightweight structural systems that make GlassPoint's technology reliable, safe, and scalable.

Working closely with Structural, Mechanical, Manufacturing, and Operations teams, you'll combine advanced engineering analysis with hands-on testing to validate innovative designs and ensure they perform under real-world conditions. From small-scale material characterization to full-scale component testing, your work will directly influence the next generation of technology.
 

Your Impact

The structures you validate will become part of some of the world's largest industrial solar thermal plants, helping heavy industry reduce emissions while improving energy security.

You'll combine engineering theory with practical experimentation, transforming test results into optimized designs and helping GlassPoint continuously improve the performance, reliability, and cost-effectiveness of its technology.

What You'll Do

Design & Improve Structural Systems

- Analyze and optimize lightweight structural systems, components, and structural connections.
- Evaluate the behavior of steel, aluminum, composite materials, and ETFE film systems.
- Support the development of innovative structural concepts for industrial solar thermal applications.
- Transform engineering insights into scalable, manufacturable design improvements.

Lead Material & Component Testing

- Plan, build, execute, and evaluate material and component tests.
- Design and instrument full-scale structural testing.
- Conduct small-specimen material testing to characterize material behavior.
- Analyze test results and translate findings into engineering recommendations.

Develop & Validate Engineering Models

- Develop, calibrate, and improve nonlinear finite element (FEA) models.
- Predict structural behavior using numerical simulations.
- Validate simulation results through physical testing.
- Continuously refine engineering models to improve design accuracy.

Collaborate Across Engineering

- Work closely with Structural, Mechanical, Manufacturing, and Operations teams.
- Support design decisions through data-driven engineering.
- Contribute to solving complex structural challenges across international projects.
- Share technical expertise and help drive continuous innovation.

Who You Are

You're someone who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges and turning analysis into practical solutions.

You combine analytical thinking with a hands-on mindset and enjoy moving between simulations, laboratory testing, and real-world engineering. You're curious, collaborative, and motivated by seeing your work become part of technologies that make a global impact.

Ideally, you'll bring:

- A degree in Structural Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline (ideally with a background in construction, civil engineering, or automotive engineering).
- Several years of experience in structural, material, or component testing.
- Experience working with nonlinear material behavior and structural analysis.
- Strong experience with numerical modelling and nonlinear FEA.
- Hands-on experience planning and executing engineering tests.
- Familiarity with sensors, instrumentation, and measurement systems.
- A structured, analytical, and independent working style.
- Confidence working in an international engineering environment.
- Excellent English communication skills; German is an advantage.
- Experience with foundation systems for solar structures, soil testing, rammed piles, ground screws, or percussion drilling is a plus.
What You'll Find at GlassPoint

- Real ownership and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact from day one.
- Exceptional colleagues from diverse disciplines who challenge, support, and learn from each other.
- Complex challenges that require curiosity, collaboration, and innovation.
- An international team united by a shared purpose and ambitious goals.
- The adventure of helping build the future of industrial decarbonization.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Senior Strategic Project Manager (f/m/d) within the Grid Technologies Switchgears Network Optimization organization, you will play a key role in driving and supporting global transformation initiatives across our international manufacturing network. Working closely with stakeholders across functions and regions, you will contribute significantly to the successful transformation of our factory network and the achievement of strategic business objectives.

In this position, you will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and managing complex strategic projects and transformation programs. You will ensure the successful delivery of projects by meeting defined targets related to quality, schedule, and budget while maintaining alignment with overall business goals. Acting as a central coordination point, you will facilitate collaboration between global teams and drive sustainable change across the organization.

Reporting directly to the Head of Network Optimization, you will oversee both the technical and commercial success of assigned projects in accordance with project-specific objectives and target agreements. Leveraging your strong project management expertise and international experience, you will support decision-making processes, manage stakeholder expectations, and ensure effective execution of strategic initiatives.

This role is ideally suited for an experienced Business Project Manager with a proven track record in transformation and change initiatives. If you are a highly organized professional with excellent coordination skills, a strategic mindset, and a passion for leading complex international projects, we look forward to receiving your application.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Develop and manage the Network Optimization roadmap 
* Lead cross-functional strategic programs 
* Set up planning & reporting structure for tracking & following up on the progress of the Programs 
* Responsible for the overall success of the programs, leading the project team, managing and reporting to Steering Committee and stakeholders 
* Drive footprint and portfolio optimization studies 
* Facilitate executive governance and performance reviews 
* Identification and sharing of improvements and best practices within the Switchgear Factory Network 

What You Bring

* Master’s degree in Engineering, Energy Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline

* Extensive experience within Grid Technologies, Switchgear execution units, and related business functions
* Strong coordination, communication, and stakeholder management skills in an international and cross-functional environment
